Messages.Author: Gord Culleton
Messages.Body:
Steven Bauer (ba...@wiliki.eng.hawaii.edu) writes:
> I have a question about the card Vast Wealth.
> What happens to the piece of equipment if the minion decides not to
> be equiped with it? Is it put back in the library or discarded?
> Thanks in advance,
>
> Steven Bauer
> email: ba...@wiliki.eng.hawaii.edu

Well, you can't use the action associated with Vast
Wealth and then decide you don't want the equipment.
If you use VW, you *must* pay the cost, even if you
can't afford the cost in pool. If you can't afford
the next piece, you are ousted. Who says money can
buy anything?
Jere Culleton
(Rush Rules!!!)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <DA72w...@news.hawaii.edu>,

Steven Bauer <ba...@wiliki.eng.hawaii.edu> wrote:
>I have a question about the card Vast Wealth.
>
>What happens to the piece of equipment if the minion decides not to
>be equiped with it? Is it put back in the library or discarded?
>

Q: What happens to the blood if a vampire decides not to receive it after
hunting?

A: That is not an option.

Similarily - the acting minion cannot choose not to equip with the equipment
drawn after a successful Vast Wealth-induced action. If the equipment
costs enough to oust his Methuselah, then his Methuselah is ousted.
You only get options described on the card or in the rulebook.
